name: Dedica
short_description: Agent-readiness checker that scores whether AI agents can find, use and pay on your website.
long_description: Dedica scans a site the way AI agents browse it and returns an agent-readiness score with prioritized fixes and handable prompts for coding agents. Differentiator is GEO/agent navigation checks (discovery, access, actions, payments) plus an optional agent-facing version of the site and MCP endpoints. Free covers a limited score and top fixes; Pro is $79/month for more pages and agent payments; a one-time fix kit is also sold.

name: Empacer
short_description: Voice-first AI business assistant for SMB owners that drafts posts, replies and docs for approval.
long_description: Empacer remembers business context from a short setup, then turns spoken requests into customer replies, social posts, invoices and plans. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval. Available on web and Android (iOS via browser). Differentiator is owner-facing voice ops with persistent business memory rather than a generic chatbot. Official pricing page states the assistant is paid only (no free assistant tier); exact amounts shown at checkout.

name: Specsight
short_description: Product observability that learns features from code and turns releases into plain-language updates.
long_description: Specsight connects read-only to code repositories, maintains a live product spec/feature map, and generates plain-language product updates and release notes for support, sales, marketing and leadership. Differentiator is a living product map derived from code rather than manually written docs. Standard plan is €150/month (up to 3 projects, 50 members, 200 syncs); 7-day free trial available; 14-day money-back on first payment.

name: BotGauge
short_description: AI agent red-teaming and evaluation platform with traces, regression checks and guardrails.
long_description: BotGauge runs adaptive red-team attacks and real-world scenarios against AI agents, shows full traces (prompts, tool calls, paths), and turns findings into evaluation suites and safeguards for ongoing releases. Aimed at teams shipping RAG, support, voice or multi-agent systems. Public homepage focuses on agent reliability; a clear Free/Freemium/Premium mapping for the agent product was not verified on the pricing page during this check, so pricing is left blank.

name: Floot
short_description: Connector that builds full-stack web and mobile apps from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor chats.
long_description: Floot plugs into Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor so users describe an app in chat and get a hosted full-stack app with database, auth, email and a live URL, including app-store publish flows. Differentiator is staying inside the chat/agent the user already pays for while Floot handles backend and hosting. Official pricing: Free $0 (100 build actions/day), Pro $25/month, Power $100/month.

name: Spacesheep
short_description: Shared workspace where people and AI agents publish interactive pages, comment and version together.
long_description: Spacesheep (YC F26) lets agents publish HTML/docs/dashboards/mockups to private URLs that humans and other agents can view, comment on and edit, with full version history. Works via MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and more. Differentiator is cross-agent shareable artifacts with comments and e-sign. Free forever plan; Pro $4.50/month; Max $9/month; Team $10/member/month.

name: ClawsGO Science
short_description: AI research agent with a cloud lab that searches literature, runs code and drafts cited papers.
long_description: ClawsGO Science is an end-to-end scientific research agent: from a question it searches academic sources, analyzes data, writes/runs code on a cloud host (or connected lab GPU), and delivers reports, LaTeX drafts and figures. Differentiator is unattended multi-hour cloud runs with a replayable trace and AI-native LaTeX workbench. Free tier includes 1,500 permanent signup credits; Plus $9.9/month, Pro $29.9/month, Max $99.9/month, Ultra $299.9/month (verified on official pricing page).

name: Cedric AI
short_description: AI teammate that joins meetings, presents slides, takes notes and completes follow-ups with approval.
long_description: Cedric is a shared AI employee for teams: it joins Google Meet/Zoom/Teams calls, can present decks slide-by-slide, posts recaps, drafts follow-ups and works in Slack/Discord/Telegram with a shared company memory and 3,000+ tool connections. Swiss-based; asks before sending anything outward. Workspaces start with 100,000 free credits ($50) with no card; Starter $19/month; Max $99/month — plans differ by credit volume only.

name: Hera
short_description: AI-native creative canvas for generating images, designs and motion ads with editable layers.
long_description: Hera is a YC-backed creative canvas where users brief multiple AI agents to generate images, layered designs and short motion/ads on one board, then edit every generation as layers. Differentiator is staying on one canvas from brief to animation with brand kits and multi-agent direction. Homepage offers get-started-for-free; paid Pro plans exist for higher usage (exact public price table partly app-gated; Freemium verified from free start).

name: Xmind Agent
short_description: Conversational AI inside Xmind that builds and edits mind maps from chat, files and links.
long_description: Xmind Agent (spotlighted with Xmind 2027 around late Oct 2026) lets users create, research, expand and reorganize mind maps through conversation, ingesting PDFs, webpages, YouTube links and images. Also ships Xmind MCP and a ChatGPT plugin so other agents can read/edit maps. Available on web, desktop and Android. Freemium: Free $0 and Pro ~$4.92/mo (annual) include limited AI credits; Premium ~$8.25/mo adds monthly AI credits.

name: Entire
short_description: Git forge for agent-human collaboration with Trails, continuous memory and agent session storage.
long_description: Entire, led by former GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke, is a distributed Git-compatible forge built for agentic coding. It replaces pull requests with Trails (agent-scored evals), stores agent sessions/prompts with commits as Continuous Memory, and offers agentic search across code and sessions. Positioned for high-throughput agent push/clone workloads. Public pricing was not published on the homepage during verification, so pricing is left blank.

name: Treg
short_description: Pay-per-call MCP catalog of 4,100+ marketing and enrichment APIs for coding agents.
long_description: Treg is an OpenRouter-style registry for agent tools: one key unlocks 4,100+ endpoints across 100+ providers (people enrichment, SEO, ads, social, scraping) billed per call at provider rates with 0% markup. Connect via MCP from Claude Code, Codex and similar agents. Differentiator is avoiding monthly data-tool seats for occasional agent runs. $1 free credit to start; bring-your-own-provider-key supported.

name: Simulon
short_description: iPhone AR app that places AI neural assets in the real world and captures reactive photos/videos.
long_description: Simulon turns photos, sketches or text into neural assets you place in your surroundings via AR, then capture photoreal images or action videos that respond to the scene (Reality-Aware Rendering). Free tier: 100 one-time starter credits for library subjects. Plus $14.99/month for custom subjects; Pro $39.99/month for 3× usage and studio-tier video. iPhone now; Android coming soon.

name: Vaani
short_description: No-code platform to build, deploy and improve voice AI phone agents with memory and call screening.
short_description_fr: Plateforme no-code pour créer et déployer des agents vocaux IA au téléphone, avec mémoire des appels.
long_description: Vaani lets teams describe a phone agent in plain language (Teacher AI builds the prompt, voice and tools), connect a knowledge base and go live on a real number. Features include cross-call memory, call screening handling, warm/live transfers and structured data after each call. Pay-as-you-go via prepaid wallet with a ₹1/min platform fee plus model and telephony costs; Enterprise is custom.
features: Teacher AI agent builder; multilingual low-latency voice (~450ms p90); cross-call memories; call screening; warm/live transfers; integrations & API
howTo: Describe the call goal to Teacher AI, answer its clarifying questions, review the prompt diff, connect knowledge and tools, then top up the wallet and go live on a phone number.

name: Scape
short_description: AI desktop email client that prioritizes your inbox, prepares contextual drafts and records meetings locally.
short_description_fr: Client e-mail IA pour bureau qui trie ta boîte, prépare des brouillons et enregistre tes réunions en local.
long_description: Scape is a desktop email client that uses context from email, meeting transcripts, calendar and attachments to surface what matters and prepare replies you review and send. It records meetings locally on Mac without a bot joining, in 99 languages, and keeps customer conversations organized. Free plan ($0, unlimited inboxes); Plus $20/month; Max $100/month.
features: Priority inbox with auto-labels; contextual draft replies; local meeting recording (Meet, Teams, FaceTime, in person); 99-language transcription; email-based CRM; automations (Plus)
howTo: Install the desktop app, connect your email account and calendar, let Scape sort the inbox, then review and send the drafts it prepares; click record when a meeting starts.

name: Strawberry
short_description: AI browser with companions that research, extract data, draft and run scheduled tasks across websites.
short_description_fr: Navigateur IA avec des « compagnons » qui recherchent, extraient des données et rédigent pour toi.
long_description: Strawberry is a web browser with built-in AI companions that learn your workflows and can work across any website and connected apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion...) — e.g. sourcing candidates, building lead lists or drafting follow-ups. Browsing is free; credits are used only when companions act. Free 500 credits/month; Intern $20/month; Part-Time $85; Full-Time $250.
features: AI companions acting on any website; app connectors (Gmail, Slack, Notion); scheduled tasks; interactive dashboards; memory across chats; no training on your content
howTo: Download Strawberry, browse normally, then ask a companion to do a task (research, data extraction, outreach draft) or schedule it to run on its own.

name: UnleashX
short_description: Platform to 'hire' AI employees by role that run workflows across your CRM and tools, voice and video included.
short_description_fr: Plateforme pour « embaucher » des employés IA par rôle qui exécutent tes workflows dans ton CRM et tes outils.
long_description: UnleashX lets teams pick an AI employee role, connect their CRM and tools, set rules and hand over end-to-end workflows, with humans stepping in only when needed. It includes voice and video agents and Leasha, a super-agent. Pay-as-you-go: free to start with 1,000 credits, then usage plus model costs, no monthly commitment.
features: Role-based AI employees; CRM and tool connections; voice and video agents; custom forms; Leasha super agent; human-in-the-loop handoff
howTo: Sign up for free credits, choose an AI employee role, connect your CRM and tools, set its rules, then let it run workflows and step in when it escalates.

name: Testifly
short_description: Autonomous AI QA that discovers your web app's flows from a URL and keeps end-to-end tests running.
short_description_fr: QA autonome par IA : à partir d'une URL, découvre les parcours de ton appli web et maintient les tests E2E.
long_description: Testifly crawls a web app from its URL and logins, discovers features, creates end-to-end tests and adapts them when the UI changes, with a coverage map, CI/CD API and integrations (Jira, Linear, Notion, Slack on Growth+). 30-day free trial without card; Starter $29/month, Growth $89, Business $249, Enterprise custom.
features: Automatic feature discovery; self-healing E2E tests; coverage map; blast-radius analysis (Growth+); CI/CD execution API; Tessa AI assistant
howTo: Create a free account, enter your app URL and test logins, review the discovered coverage map, then run tests in CI via the execution API.

name: Clayzo
short_description: Free animation engine that lets coding agents like Claude Code, Codex or Cursor create motion graphics.
short_description_fr: Moteur d'animation gratuit pour que tes agents de code (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) créent du motion design.
long_description: Clayzo is a free animation engine built for coding agents: you ask Claude Code, Codex or Cursor for motion graphics, product animations or interactive web animations, the agent writes them in code and checks every frame, and you export a video or play it live on the web or natively in Swift.
features: Agent-written animations; frame-by-frame review by the agent; video export; live web playback; native Swift playback
howTo: Run `npx clayzo@latest init` in your project, then ask your coding agent to create the animation and export or embed it.

name: Greta.sh
short_description: AI app and website builder whose sites keep publishing SEO/AEO content and fixing issues on their own.
short_description_fr: Créateur d'applis et de sites IA dont le site publie seul du contenu SEO/AEO et corrige ses problèmes.
long_description: Greta.sh builds a live website or full-stack app from a description, then its 'self-growing' mode researches what customers search for, publishes articles and pages aimed at Google and AI answer engines, and fixes SEO and speed issues. Free plan with 5 daily credits; Starter from $5/month (promo, list $20); Pro $20 (list $50); Business $200.
features: Prompt-to-website/app builder; automatic SEO and AEO content; design systems; custom domains; GitHub version control (Pro); database (Pro)
howTo: Describe your idea, let Greta build the site, connect a custom domain, then enable self-growing so it publishes and optimizes content weekly.

name: Faylee
short_description: Bug reports with screen, console and network in one link that your coding agent can fix via MCP.
short_description_fr: Rapports de bug (écran, console, réseau) en un seul lien, que ton agent de code peut corriger via MCP.
long_description: Faylee is a Chrome extension that records the screen, console, network requests and steps behind a bug on one timeline and shares it as a link; secrets are redacted in the browser. Its MCP server lets Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or OpenCode read the report and fix the bug. Free for 3 members and 30 recordings/month; Team $15 per recording member/month.
features: Screen + console + network recording; instant replay; auto-redaction of secrets; MCP server for coding agents; 13 integrations (Linear, Jira, GitHub, Slack, Sentry...); customer bug-report widget
howTo: Install the Chrome extension, record or replay the bug, share the link, then paste it into Claude Code or Cursor after adding Faylee's MCP server.

name: Hyperresearch
short_description: Agentic deep-research service that returns cited reports with every claim checked against its source.
short_description_fr: Service de recherche approfondie par agents qui livre des rapports sourcés, chaque affirmation vérifiée.
long_description: Hyperresearch runs multi-step research across several AI search engines and 40+ data sources, then delivers a report with the source list and a claims table with quotes; sources are kept in a searchable vault. An Answers MCP and API are also offered. Priced per run: Light $9, Deep $49; no subscription (first Deep run free when adding a card).
features: Cited long-form reports; claim-by-claim verification; searchable source vault; Answers MCP and API; per-run flat pricing; spend caps
howTo: Create an account, ask a question and choose a Light or Deep run, then read the report and its evidence table; or call the Answers API from your agent.

name: Synter Canvas
short_description: AI agent that builds, launches and optimizes ad campaigns across 40+ ad platforms with guardrails.
short_description_fr: Agent IA qui crée, lance et optimise tes campagnes pub sur plus de 40 plateformes, avec garde-fous.
long_description: Synter lets AI agents manage advertising across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, retail media and DSPs through one MCP, CLI and API, with preflight guardrails, cross-platform reporting and creative generation. No percentage of ad spend; actions are metered. Solo $20/month (with $20 usage credits); Scale $500/month per workspace with Autopilot; Custom for agencies.
features: Universal Ads MCP/CLI/API (43 platforms); campaign launch and optimization; preflight guardrails; AI creative generation; cross-platform reporting and attribution; CRM sync (Scale)
howTo: Connect your ad accounts (no card needed to read), connect your agent via MCP or use the app, review proposed changes, then add a plan to launch campaigns.

name: Display
short_description: Workspace to publish, share and organize the docs, prototypes and apps your AI agents create.
short_description_fr: Espace pour publier, partager et ranger les docs, prototypes et applis que créent tes agents IA.
long_description: Display hosts HTML and Markdown files produced by Claude, Codex, Cursor or scripts via a CLI, organizes them in spaces and folders, and shares them publicly or behind company sign-in, turning agent output into an internal knowledge base. Pricing is per storage and features, not seats: Free plan, Solo $9/month (yearly) or $12 monthly, Team $59, Business $199.
features: CLI publishing of agent-generated files; gated or public sharing; unlimited viewers; spaces, folders and version history; API keys; audit logs (Business)
howTo: Install the CLI, publish an HTML or Markdown file your agent produced, then share the link publicly or with your company domain.
